PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Required local server error and crash evidence capture
PluginData.Description: Required support plugin loaded by Magnetar. Captures bounded local Error/Critical logs and fatal exceptions. External report sharing and crash-dump consent are controlled separately by Quasar. Requires the Magnetar PluginSdk that exposes PluginSdk.Logging.Logger.EntryEmitted.
